    // The extent of the bounding box as a vector (Max - Min).
    BoundsSize(self: IBounded3D): Vector3D
        => self.Bounds.Min.Between(self.Bounds.Max);

    // The extent of the bounding box along X.
    BoundsWidth(self: IBounded3D): Number
        => self.BoundsSize.X;

    // The extent of the bounding box along Y.
    BoundsHeight(self: IBounded3D): Number
        => self.BoundsSize.Y;

    // The extent of the bounding box along Z.
    BoundsDepth(self: IBounded3D): Number
        => self.BoundsSize.Z;

    // The volume of the bounding box (width times height times depth).
    BoundsVolume(self: IBounded3D): Number
        => self.BoundsWidth * self.BoundsHeight * self.BoundsDepth;

    // The length of the bounding box's space diagonal.
    BoundsDiagonalLength(self: IBounded3D): Number
        => self.BoundsSize.Magnitude;

    // True when the point lies within the bounding box (inclusive).
    BoundsContainsPoint(self: IBounded3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => point.X >= self.Bounds.Min.X && point.X <= self.Bounds.Max.X
        && point.Y >= self.Bounds.Min.Y && point.Y <= self.Bounds.Max.Y
        && point.Z >= self.Bounds.Min.Z && point.Z <= self.Bounds.Max.Z;

    // True when this shape's bounds lie entirely within `outer`'s bounds (inclusive).
    FitsInside(self: IBounded3D, outer: IBounded3D): Boolean
        => self.Bounds.Min.X >= outer.Bounds.Min.X && self.Bounds.Min.Y >= outer.Bounds.Min.Y
        && self.Bounds.Min.Z >= outer.Bounds.Min.Z
        && self.Bounds.Max.X <= outer.Bounds.Max.X && self.Bounds.Max.Y <= outer.Bounds.Max.Y
        && self.Bounds.Max.Z <= outer.Bounds.Max.Z;

    // True when the two shapes' bounding boxes overlap (touching counts).
    BoundsOverlaps(self: IBounded3D, other: IBounded3D): Boolean
        => self.Bounds.Min.X <= other.Bounds.Max.X && self.Bounds.Max.X >= other.Bounds.Min.X
        && self.Bounds.Min.Y <= other.Bounds.Max.Y && self.Bounds.Max.Y >= other.Bounds.Min.Y
        && self.Bounds.Min.Z <= other.Bounds.Max.Z && self.Bounds.Max.Z >= other.Bounds.Min.Z;

    //==
    // # IPointSet2D / IPointSet3D
    //
    // No helpers are defined here: the defining points are an Array (IIndexable), so
    // the useful per-element conveniences already come from P2's generics on the
    // Points array — callers write `self.Points.IsEmpty`, `self.Points.First`,
    // `self.Points.Last`, `self.Points.Count`, `self.Points.At(i)`. Re-spelling any
    // of them at this layer would be pure rule-11 duplication. Aggregate reductions
    // (centroid, bounds) are the fold interface-gap noted at the top of the file.

    //==
    // # ILength
    //
    // Conveniences over a finite total Length. Half(Length) already comes from P1's
    // Half(IScalable); it is not respelled here.

    // True when the length is within `tolerance` of zero (a degenerate span).
    // Delegates to P1's AlmostZero(IReal, tolerance) rather than an exact == 0.0.
    IsDegenerate(self: ILength, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.Length.AlmostZero(tolerance);

    // True when this entity is longer than another length-measurable entity.
    LongerThan(self: ILength, other: ILength): Boolean
        => self.Length > other.Length;

    //==
    // # IArea
    //
    // Conveniences over a finite Area and boundary Perimeter.

    // True when the area is within `tolerance` of zero (a degenerate region).
    IsDegenerate(self: IArea, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.Area.AlmostZero(tolerance);

    // The ratio of enclosed area to boundary length; larger for "fuller" regions.
    // Precondition: non-zero perimeter.
    AreaPerimeterRatio(self: IArea): Number
        => self.Area / self.Perimeter;

    // True when this region encloses more area than another.
    LargerAreaThan(self: IArea, other: IArea): Boolean
        => self.Area > other.Area;

    // The isoperimetric quotient 4*Pi*Area / Perimeter^2: a scale-invariant
    // compactness measure in (0, 1], equal to 1 only for a disc
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isoperimetric_inequality).
    // Precondition: non-zero perimeter.
    IsoperimetricQuotient(self: IArea): Number
        => 4.0 * self.Area.Pi * self.Area / (self.Perimeter * self.Perimeter);

    //==
    // # IVolume
    //
    // Conveniences over a finite Volume and boundary SurfaceArea.

    // True when the volume is within `tolerance` of zero (a degenerate solid).
    IsDegenerate(self: IVolume, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.Volume.AlmostZero(tolerance);

    // The ratio of enclosed volume to boundary area; larger for more "compact"
    // solids. Precondition: non-zero surface area.
    VolumeSurfaceRatio(self: IVolume): Number
        => self.Volume / self.SurfaceArea;

    // True when this solid encloses more volume than another.
    LargerVolumeThan(self: IVolume, other: IVolume): Boolean
        => self.Volume > other.Volume;

    //==
    // # ICentroid2D / ICentroid3D
    //
    // Proximity of a query point to the center of mass
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centroid).

    // The straight-line distance from the centroid to a query point.
    DistanceFromCentroid(self: ICentroid2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Centroid.Between(point).Magnitude;

    // The squared distance from the centroid to a query point; avoids the square
    // root when only relative distances are compared.
    DistanceFromCentroidSquared(self: ICentroid2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Centroid.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared;

    // The straight-line distance from the centroid to a query point.
    DistanceFromCentroid(self: ICentroid3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Centroid.Between(point).Magnitude;

    // The squared distance from the centroid to a query point.
    DistanceFromCentroidSquared(self: ICentroid3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Centroid.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared;
